sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx:Quality Checks!A27:D27 and Internal Quality Checks!A27:E27 (both sheets read)
evidence: The brief delegates the contract to six notes (task/instruction.md:3). The gates and scored criteria do cover the main authored Run, custom document surface, cross-context Save, formatting, conflict and history flows (task/tests/gates/{render,constraints}/judge.toml; task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml), so this is not a demand for one criterion per action. Actual unmapped or incompletely mapped promises are: (1) ui.md:5 requires platform-modifier word movement and selection; the navigation and grapheme criteria test Home/End/arrows and Shift+Arrow, never word-modifier movement. (2) ui.md:7 requires a long UNWRAPPED horizontally reachable line, while cw_long_line_editing at functional/judge.toml:149 explicitly accepts Find instead of horizontal scrolling, allowing wrapping. (3) ui.md:17 requires operable Stop, Clear console and New; no criterion operates Clear console or New, and cw_timeout_stop_and_supersession at functional/judge.toml:185 allows a newer Run OR Stop. (4) behaviour.md:3 requires a fresh preview document per Run and ordered log/warn/info/error console output; the Render/HTML criteria exercise a log marker and cw_error_message_and_line exercises throws, with no fresh-document or mixed-level ordering probe. (5) behaviour.md:5 requires last-good restoration after Stop and time budget expiry; cw_last_good_recovery at functional/judge.toml:176 tests a failing candidate, while cw_timeout_stop_and_supersession:185 checks reason/later recovery, not the retained state after those two causes. (6) behaviour.md:7 conditionally forbids a second delayed Auto-run after manual Run; no criterion checks this when Auto-run is offered. (7) security.md:5 forbids eval, Function, WebAssembly, workers and dynamic imports, and server evaluation of saved source; cw_preview_boundary at functional/judge.toml:194 asks for only one real prohibited dynamic-execution attempt and no server-side execution test, leaving the other paths ungraded. (8) ui.md:15 requires an invalid formatting attempt to retain the draft and two-space nesting for complete HTML; polish/judge.toml:32 checks invalid-format feedback but not retention, and cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo at functional/judge.toml:140 asks only for readable nested lines. (9) ui.md:17 requires authored preview colours to remain; cw_html_preview does not check style preservation and visual/prompt.md excludes authored preview content. The raw-evidence-index.json named by the assignment is absent; no full judge-run coverage result was inferred from its absence.
counterexample: A custom editor app could pass the current probes while wrapping long lines but using Find for the tail, omitting Clear console/New and word-modifier navigation, exposing a dead Stop button while the judge chooses newer Run, reusing preview globals between Runs, showing log and thrown errors but dropping warn/info, preserving last-good only for thrown errors, scheduling a duplicate Auto-run, blocking eval but allowing Function/WebAssembly/workers/import, evaluating saved text server-side, erasing an invalid draft on Format, formatting HTML at four spaces, and stripping authored preview colours. None of those defects is ruled out by the corresponding criterion text. A conforming app with Auto-run omitted and ordinary horizontal scrolling remains permitted, so this coverage review identifies no inverse false-fail from these gaps.
suggested_fix: Add narrow browser-observable probes or strengthen existing criteria for each omitted product promise: explicit New/Clear/Stop actions, modifier word selection, actual horizontal unwrapped editing, fresh preview and ordered console levels, last-good on stop/timeout, offered Auto-run deduplication, each prohibited preview execution class, invalid-format draft retention, HTML two-space nesting and authored colours; use a valid save with an observable side effect to test that saved source is never executed on the server, and preserve separate credit for distinct outcomes.
